product_risk_or_requirement: Safety risk: a red-flag user may receive personalized nutrition advice.
current_state: Prototype has no documented adversarial test set or measured escalation performance.
product_requirement: The product must detect defined red flags and prevent personalized output until an approved human-referral experience is shown.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test profile containing eating-disorder pregnancy severe-allergy or chronic-disease red flags When it requests a meal plan Then the system refuses personalized advice records the reason and shows the approved escalation path in every test case.
evidence_needed: Versioned red-flag test suite independent test report and approval record showing 100 percent correct blocking.

product_risk_or_requirement: Clinical quality risk: generated advice may conflict with dietitian-approved guidance or become unsafe after model changes.
current_state: Prototype uses a general model but lacks an approved content corpus and change-control record.
product_requirement: The product must ground low-risk recommendations in a versioned dietitian-approved content corpus and require clinical sign-off for prompts policies and model changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a candidate content or model change When the release workflow runs Then production deployment is blocked unless a registered dietitian signs the evidence record and regression tests pass.
evidence_needed: Content approval register regression-test results model version and signed clinical review.

product_risk_or_requirement: Privacy risk: health and weight data may be collected or processed without valid consent retention limits or incident handling.
current_state: Data fields and vendor flow are proposed but no documented privacy impact review is complete.
product_requirement: The product must collect only necessary fields after explicit consent and implement retention deletion vendor-processing and breach-response controls approved by privacy review.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user in the pilot When they decline consent or request deletion Then the system does not create a personalized profile or removes eligible retained data and records the request outcome.
evidence_needed: Privacy impact assessment consent UX test retention schedule vendor data-processing assessment and incident playbook.

product_risk_or_requirement: Over-reliance risk: users may interpret a recommendation as diagnosis or treatment.
current_state: Prototype disclaimer is not tested for comprehension and escalation is not visibly persistent.
product_requirement: The product should show plain-language scope limits and a persistent route to human help beside every personalized recommendation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a low-risk user viewing a meal plan When they open the recommendation Then the page states it is not diagnosis or treatment and provides an accessible human-support route.
evidence_needed: Usability-test report screenshots and accessibility review.
